title: CHAINDROP worm backdoors 400+ npm packages via hijacked keyv maintainer
sum: Hijacked keyv maintainer account backdoored 400+ npm packages (keyv, cacheable-request, flat-cache); setup.mjs dropper exfiltrates credentials and self-propagates across 1.3B monthly downloads.
ctl: M1045 Code Signing — pin known-good versions
M1033 Limit Software Installation — audit lockfiles for keyv/cacheable-request
M1043 Credential Access Protection — rotate creds on affected build hosts

title: Microsoft Outlook NTLM-leak zero-day (CVE-2026-124194) exploited in the wild
sum: Crafted message file makes Outlook connect to an attacker server and leak an NTLMv2 hash, enabling credential theft and lateral movement; actively exploited, CISA due date Nov 24.
ctl: M1051 Update Software — apply Nov 10 Office update now
M1037 Filter Network Traffic — block outbound SMB 139/445
M1017 User Training — caution on unsolicited message files

title: Cisco Expressway hardcoded credentials (CVE-2026-76466) exploited
sum: Hardcoded credentials give unauthenticated remote root on Cisco Expressway; added to KEV Nov 23 after attackers breached four devices at a Russian organization.
ctl: M1051 Update Software — apply Cisco advisory fix
M1018 User Account Management — remove hardcoded credentials
M1047 Audit — check Erlang logs for exploitation signs

title: Apache Roller deserialization RCE (CVE-2026-129448) actively exploited
sum: Pre-auth Java deserialization in XML-RPC gives code execution as the app server; public PoC since Sep, KEV Nov 20, active exploitation, affects Roller 4.0.0-6.1.5.
ctl: M1051 Update Software — upgrade to Roller 6.1.6+
M1037 Filter Network Traffic — block /roller-services/xmlrpc at WAF
M1042 Disable or Remove Feature or Program — disable XML-RPC if unused

title: TanStack npm compromise: 42 packages shipped with valid SLSA provenance
sum: CI pipeline hijack published 42 malicious @tanstack packages across 84 versions, bearing valid OIDC/SLSA provenance — signed packages can no longer be blindly trusted.
ctl: M1045 Code Signing — verify provenance, don't trust blindly
M1033 Limit Software Installation — audit @tanstack/* lockfile versions
M1047 Audit — treat matching 1.161.9/12 versions as compromised

title: FreeSWITCH SIP code injection (CVE-2026-116779) used in ransomware
sum: Inbound SIP MESSAGE can invoke FreeSWITCH API commands as root; CISA KEV added and seen in ransomware campaigns against a widely deployed telephony platform.
ctl: M1051 Update Software — apply FreeSWITCH fix
M1037 Filter Network Traffic — restrict inbound SIP to trusted peers
M1030 Network Segmentation — isolate telephony plane

title: Cisco BroadWorks XXE (CVE-2026-20320) actively exploited
sum: XXE in Cisco BroadWorks is under active exploitation; CISA due date Nov 24. Patch per Cisco advisory.
ctl: M1051 Update Software — patch per Cisco advisory
M1016 Vulnerability Scanning — confirm exposure
M1047 Audit — review access logs

title: UnrealIRCd delimiter neutralization (CVE-2026-114713) on KEV
sum: Delimiter neutralization in UnrealIRCd added to CISA KEV Nov 13; upgrade to remediate.
ctl: M1051 Update Software — upgrade UnrealIRCd
M1037 Filter Network Traffic — restrict inbound IRC

title: Vanderbilt University ransomware: 1M+ SSNs allegedly exfiltrated
sum: BYOD ransomware group claimed an attack on Vanderbilt, allegedly exfiltrating 1M+ SSNs; university took campus WiFi, Okta and Brightspace offline. Ongoing.
ctl: M1053 Data Backup — ensure recoverable backups
M1030 Network Segmentation — isolate BYOD from critical systems
M1026 Privileged Account Management — protect Okta/admin access

title: AI-assisted fraud triggers unauthorized payments at Indian banks
sum: Attackers used AI to trigger unauthorized payments at multiple Indian financial institutions, an emerging TTP that bypasses traditional transaction monitoring.
ctl: M1032 Multi-factor Authentication — step-up auth on high-value transfers
M1047 Audit — strengthen transaction monitoring for AI-driven patterns
M1036 Account Use Policies — restrict unusual payment flows

title: Ivanti EPM pre-auth SQLi RCE (CVE-2026-121653) to watch
sum: CVSS 9.8 pre-auth RCE in Ivanti Endpoint Manager Core via SQLi, patched in Nov 2026; no confirmed exploitation yet but PoC likely.
ctl: M1051 Update Software — apply Ivanti EPM 2024 SU8
M1016 Vulnerability Scanning — confirm exposure
M1035 Limit Access to Resource Over Network — restrict Core access

title: Windows AD DS RCE/EoP (CVE-2026-118146/118148) flagged likely-exploited
sum: Active Directory Domain Services RCE and elevation flaws rated 'Exploitation More Likely' by Microsoft; not yet confirmed exploited but AD is a prime target.
ctl: M1051 Update Software — apply November Patch Tuesday
M1015 Active Directory Configuration — harden AD DS
M1026 Privileged Account Management — protect domain admins
